title: HIV Service Engagement (Socio-Behavioral Feedbacks)
preview: How do stigma, social support, and care experiences interact to shape HIV testing and PrEP uptake? I model how these socio-behavioral feedbacks propagate through service engagement over time.
imageAlt: Causal loop diagram for HIV stigma and service engagement

title: Maternal Health Service Delivery
preview: How do referral pathways, community trust, and service readiness shape maternal and neonatal outcomes? I use systems modeling to evaluate how maternal health interventions unfold across real-world settings.

title: Causal Maps to Dynamical Models
preview: How do you turn a qualitative causal map into a model you can calibrate and simulate? I develop methods that bridge participatory systems mapping with statistical modeling and intervention evaluation.
imageAlt: Causal map to quantitative model translation graphic

title: Estimating Latent Populations for HIV Surveillance
preview: Some populations are difficult to measure directly. I integrate census, survey, and surveillance data to estimate hard-to-reach populations for HIV surveillance and resource allocation.

title: Eliciting Expert-Informed Causal Structures
preview: What do researchers and practitioners already know about how an intervention works? I facilitate participatory modeling to elicit causal assumptions, feedback loops, and context-specific barriers.

title: Decision-Support Tools for Policy Evaluation
preview: How can policymakers explore intervention scenarios under uncertainty? I build interactive tools that make complex model outputs interpretable and useful for planning.

title: Participatory Survey Methods for Smoking Cessation
preview: What do people actually want from a smoking cessation program? I use wiki-survey methods to crowdsource and prioritize behavioral insights in an open, iterative format.
